I had such a great experience at Lucky Dog Pet Grooming! I brought in my Maltipoo for a full groom, and they did an amazing job. From the moment we walked in, the staff was friendly, professional, and clearly cared about making him feel comfortable.

They listened carefully to what I wanted—especially with the teddy bear cut—and nailed it! His coat came out super soft, evenly trimmed, and styled perfectly. They also cleaned his ears, clipped his nails just right, and gave him the best bath. He smelled great without being overly perfumed, which I loved.

He usually gets a little anxious during grooming, but not this time. When I picked him up, he was happy, tail wagging, and looked absolutely adorable.

The shop was also very clean and organized—everything felt safe and calm. I’ve tried a few groomers before, but Lucky Dog is by far the best. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend them to anyone with a small dog!
They did an amazing job with Benji’s haircut, and it also grows out very nicely! Highly recommend!
Have been bringing my dog Jax for years. They never fail, absolutely amazing services every time!
The experience I had with my dog here was exceptional!!!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE – They butchered my dog’s haircut. I brought my bernedoodle in for a teddy bear cut and left very clear instructions. My dog’s coat was beautifully grown out, and I emphasized that I did not want it shaved. When I came back to pick him up, I was absolutely devastated. They had completely shaved his entire body, leaving him patchy, uneven, and unrecognizable.This was not a small misunderstanding — this was complete negligence and a total disregard for what I asked. My dog’s coat will take months to grow back, and the emotional toll this has taken on both of us is no joke. This was not just a bad haircut — it was a total violation of trust.This business should not be allowed to operate on animals if they cannot follow basic grooming instructions. I’ve posted the before and after photos to show the damage they caused. I wouldn’t wish this experience on anyone. If you care about your pet, DO. NOT. BRING. THEM. HERE. I will be reporting this to the Better Business Bureau and any other relevant regulatory bodies.
AMAZING SERVICE! Great customer service very loving to my dog and extremely caring. Grooming was done great and exactly how I asked. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLLACE
